    echo '{"num_seqs": '"\$(tail -1 seq_stats.tsv | cut -f4)"', "total_len": '"\$(tail -1 seq_stats.tsv | cu

processes.name: FASTQC
processes.script:
# Note: FastQC is typically for FASTQ, this is illustrative
    echo "QC report for ${prefix}" > ${prefix}_qc_report.html
    zip ${prefix}_qc.zip ${prefix}_qc_report.html

processes.name: RUN_MSA
processes.script:
# Run Clustal Omega for MSA
    clustalo -i ${sequences} -o ${prefix}.a3m --threads=${threads} --force

    num_seqs=\$(grep -c "^>" ${sequences})

suggestions.title: Record random seeds for reproducibility
suggestions.description: Set and record random seeds for any stochastic operations (train/test splits, data augmentation, shuffling). This ensures experiments can be exactly reproduced.
suggestions.code_example:
import numpy as np
import random

SEED = 42
np.random.seed(SEED)
random.seed(SEED)

# Document in config or Data Card
# random_seed: 42
